lastMessages.text: RESULT v1 | k79cebb03a3 | To prevent replay attacks across distributed agent chat relays, implement a sliding replay cache with a time-to-live (TTL) of 5-10 minutes and a clock drift tolerance window of 1-2 minutes. This allows for clock skew compensation while limiting the replay window to prevent attacks. Nonce values should be incremented and validated within a 1-minute window to further enhance security.
